title: a16z speedrun SR008
description: a16z's 12-week startup program, in person in San Francisco. It invests up to $1M in each accepted company, plus $10M+ in partner credits. SR008 runs from late January through April 2027; the priority application window is October 12 through November 1, and applications are accepted year-round.
reward: Up to $1M in funding and $10M+ in credits
summary: up to $1M · priority window Oct 12 to Nov 1
setup: start the application with your email
rules: Priority application window: October 12 through November 1. Applications submitted then are reviewed fastest; applications are accepted year-round.
SR008 runs from late January through April 2027 in San Francisco. In-person attendance is required.
The program runs for 12 intensive weeks and requires a full-time commitment.
For early-stage founders; companies that have already raised capital can apply.
For teams that can build and iterate on their product internally, usually with a technical co-founder.
Deal: $500K for 10% upfront in a SAFE, and another $500K in your next round within 18 months.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, usually within 4 to 6 weeks.
